name: Industrial Equipment Mount
description: An aluminum 6061-T6 wall bracket for mounting heavy industrial equipment. Mounts to a vertical wall via six M8 bolts in a 3×2 grid and cantilevers a 100 kg load 120 mm from the wall face. Minimize mass while surviving the load. Aluminum’s high specific strength rewards thin-walled topology; its density (2.2× PLA) punishes solid designs.
